decisions.reason: As a 2023 safety-shoe line that gained its own page in 2024, it appears integrated into the core footwear business and the firm is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course quickly.

This comfort insole has lower visible commitment because it remained only mentioned on the website, but as a low-risk complement to the footwear range the firm is still more likely to retain it than withdraw it.

The supportive insole also shows limited public escalation and may overlap with other insole offers, yet management would likely keep it for now because it fits the existing portfolio and sunk development costs favor persistence.
The ergonomic safety-shoe series had its own page in both 2023 and 2024, signaling strong commitment to a core product area that matches the firm's innovation narrative and makes withdrawal unlikely.
Although more specialized, the firefighter and rescue boots moved from a mention to their own page in 2024, suggesting rising commitment and a willingness to give the line more time in the market.

Because the moulded insole was presented as a flagship, stayed on the home page, and was supported by a concrete customer-use example in 2024, management is very unlikely to take it off the market soon.
